name: East Kalimantan
summary_text: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier. It is one of the eight provinces documented in an international NGO's analysis of discriminatory provincial regulations (province, district and city laws overlapping national law), so a legal divergence exists, but no incident documentation was found for this unit and no deviation from the national position was material enough to score separately; it is therefore assessed at the national score.

sources.title: Indonesia’s Transgender Community Is Facing Growing Repression – The Diplomat
sources.claim_summary: Feature (14 August 2026): 'Indonesia's Transgender Community Is Facing Growing Repression' — an October 2025 presidential decree lists 'the promotion of LGBTQ+ culture' among nonmilitary threats alongside terrorism and drug addiction; in July 2026 mobs attacked trans women in several cities including West Java, with no prosecutions reported; civil society describes rapidly worsening conditions.
